scope: Doubled-frequency refinement of the converged 167-radius T-released cool H/He closure (Gate 3), and the force/heating/luminosity profile criteria used for both the frequency and the 167/333 spatial pair. Extends the frozen-state scope of benchmarks/cmfgen_frequency_plan.json ('frozen-state relativistic/advection transport only') to converged non-LTE equilibria: each state is solved and audited on its own grid; no frozen-state or endpoint-only claim.
declared: 2026-10-06, before any 167-radius doubled-frequency pass exists (results/nk167_dfreq absent) and before any converged 167-radius state exists; production_certified false

frequencies.source: baseline: OUTGEN/QSTARS_ALI_STATS of results/cmfgen_ali_lambda167; expected: CONT_FREQ of results/cmfgen_recovery_T9_frequency2 (full recipe, same MIN_CF/MAX_CF/VINF/SIG_GAU_KMS/MAX_DOP); the start_base OUTGEN must report it

not_used: Report 20's subset (results/nk_dfreq: 84 radii, build 23, INC_AD/INC_ADV=F, V_CROSS 750 and AMP_DIS 1.4 kept; 84,776 frequencies) is superseded and is not the Gate 3 recipe.
unchanged: radius grid (167 radii) and core rays
x0 restart results/cmfgen_ali_lambda167 and equation table results/nk167_adv/transfer/replace_167.txt
INC_AD=T, INC_ADV=T and every other VADAT/IN_ITS control
executable (build 31) and every solver argument of the converged 167 stage, including --ultra-frac/--ultra-weight
convergence test (--tol 1e-3 over variables holding > 1e-10 of their element plus n_e and T) and the closing_phase of benchmarks/cmfgen_cool_validation_plan.json
start: --start-step <final cleaned 167-radius state>/QSTARS_STEP.bin with the same --x0 (state dimensions NT x ND are frequency independent; no interpolation)
per_state_prerequisites: Both states pass every per-state audit (benchmarks/cmfgen_cool_validation_plan.json requirements[0]: electron balance, global and cumulative radiation energy, last native correction on all levels, populations/charge, spectral material temperature, recombination coverage) before any differencing. Otherwise the pair is reported as not comparable, never as a pass.

applies_to: frequency pair: 167 radii vs 167 radii doubled frequency (all radii shared)
spatial pair: 167 vs 333 radii (shared radii: 333[::2] = 167, exact)
refinement_profile_criteria.inputs: profiles.npz written by validate_cmfgen_component.audit in each state's verify_<state>_audit directory; radii matched to relative 1e-9 and compared at the coarser run's radii; b = the finer run
refinement_profile_criteria.state: scripts/compare_resolution.py base-pass mode: T and n_e relative, dominant H I/He I/He II/He III fractions absolute where both exceed 0.01, against benchmarks/cmfgen_validation_plan.json profile_refinement_relative (0.01); unchanged

definitions.E_comoving, F_comoving, P_comoving, radi: max over shared radii of |a - b| / |b|; points where either value is non-finite are counted and fail the metric (radiation_profile_relative of benchmarks/cmfgen_frequency_plan.json and limits.profile_relative of benchmarks/cmfgen_mesh_plan.json)
definitions.Lscale: max(|L_b(inner)|, |L_b(outer)|) of luminosity_lab, the normalization of the audit's cumulative radiation-energy ledger (scripts/audit_cmfgen_cool.py)
definitions.luminosity_lab_over_Lscale: max over shared radii of |L_a(r) - L_b(r)| / Lscale; the emergent |L_a(outer) - L_b(outer)| / |L_b(outer)| is reported
definitions.cumulative_heating_over_Lscale: Q(r) = 4 pi integral from the inner radius to r of r'^2 heating_comoving dr' (trapezoid on each run's own grid, evaluated at the shared radii); max over shared radii of |Q_a - Q_b| / Lscale. Net heating is a near-cancelling difference, so pointwise heating_comoving differences, normalized by max |heating_comoving| of b, are reported and not gated

refinement_profile_criteria.pending_reason: Luminosity and heating normalizations are new metric definitions for an existing requirement ('force and heating response must converge under mesh/frequency refinement', benchmarks/cmfgen_cool_validation_plan.json requirements[1]); declared before any result, but they define how that requirement is applied, so they need the user's approval before a PASS relies on them.

failure_handling: A failed pair is retained; thresholds are never raised. A further 4x frequency grid (each recipe key refined once more in the same way) may be declared, in a new file and before it runs, only to establish a convergence trend. A frequency-resolution failure is numerical, never physics.
known_open_check: Two-photon USE_RAD reads the conjugate-frequency J from the in-place EDDFACTOR copied from the 43,314-frequency restart (subs/two/get_j_for_two_phot.f); its effect on the doubled-grid residual is unquantified and is to be measured (A/B base pass at x0) before the doubled solve is accepted.
